issue.title: Wire the saved-query picker modal for the Agents tab agents-live namespace
issue.description: Proposed by sase-zf.4 note #1 and confirmed by the sase-zf land agent. Epic sase-zf gave the top-level Agents tab the shared agents-live boolean query dialect with an auto-hiding AgentsFilterBar, including inline saved-query slots via the `#N`/`#` grammar (namespace `agents-live` in src/sase/ace/saved_queries.py). The Artifacts panes additionally offer a browsable saved-query picker modal (`start_saved_query_mode` / `open_saved_query_picker`, opened with `*`) for listing, selecting, and managing slots; that picker was deliberately not wired for the agents-live namespace, matching the epic plan's minimal saved-slot scope ("#N grammar ... generalizing artifacts_query_history.py only as far as needed"). Wire the picker for the Agents tab: open it from the AgentsFilterBar session (`*` key parity with the Artifacts panes), list/apply/delete agents-live slots, respect the agents_unified_query flag (Off state keeps today's behavior), and cover it with widget tests plus a both-flag-state sweep.

task_type_fields.proposal: A browsable saved-query picker modal for the Agents tab's agents-live saved-slot namespace, matching the Artifacts panes' '*' picker (start_saved_query_mode/open_saved_query_picker): list, apply, and delete slots from the AgentsFilterBar session.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-zf (closed) scoped Agents-tab saved queries to the inline #N/# grammar per its plan; the picker UI is an additive enhancement discovered during phase sase-zf.4, not unfinished epic work.

payload.description: The agents_unified_query flag bead owns eventual legacy-branch deletion; the picker must stay flag-aware until sase-zg retires the flag.
